tests.name: createQuestionThemeCreationDtoShell should return a shell with all fields set to undefined when called.
useFetchStatus fetchStatus should have idle status when initialized.
useFetchStatus isIdle should be true when status is idle.
useFetchStatus isIdle should be false when status is pending.
useFetchStatus isIdle should be false when status is success.
useFetchStatus isIdle should be false when status is error.
useFetchStatus isPending should be false when status is idle.
useFetchStatus isPending should be true when status is pending.
useFetchStatus isPending should be false when status is success.
useFetchStatus isPending should be false when status is error.
useFetchStatus isSuccess should be false when status is idle.
useFetchStatus isSuccess should be false when status is pending.
useFetchStatus isSuccess should be true when status is success.
useFetchStatus isSuccess should be false when status is error.
useFetchStatus isError should be false when status is idle.
useFetchStatus isError should be false when status is pending.
useFetchStatus isError should be false when status is success.
useFetchStatus isError should be true when status is error.
useFetchStatus setFetchStatusToPending should set status to pending when called.
useFetchStatus setFetchStatusToSuccess should set status to success when called.
useFetchStatus setFetchStatusToError should set status to error when called.
useAsyncAction execute should call setFetchStatusToPending when called.
useAsyncAction execute should call the action with provided arguments when called.
useAsyncAction execute should call setFetchStatusToSuccess when action resolves.
useAsyncAction execute should return the result when action resolves.
useAsyncAction execute should call setFetchStatusToError when action rejects.
useAsyncAction execute should call onError with the error when action rejects.
useAsyncAction execute should return undefined when action rejects.
useAsyncAction execute should not call setFetchStatusToSuccess when action rejects.
useAsyncAction execute should not call setFetchStatusToError when action resolves.
useAsyncAction fetchStatus should expose the fetchStatus ref from useFetchStatus when called.
useAsyncAction isIdle should expose the isIdle computed ref from useFetchStatus when called.
useAsyncAction isPending should expose the isPending computed ref from useFetchStatus when called.
useAsyncAction isSuccess should expose the isSuccess computed ref from useFetchStatus when called.
useAsyncAction isError should expose the isError computed ref from useFetchStatus when called.
useAppToast addSuccessToast should add toast with success defaults when called with no extra options.
useAppToast addSuccessToast should add toast with merged options when called with extra options.
useAppToast addSuccessToast should override default title when a title is provided in options.
useAppToast addErrorToast should add toast with error defaults when called with no extra options.
useAppToast addErrorToast should add toast with merged options when called with extra options.
useAppToast addErrorToast should override default title when a title is provided in options.
Localization Shell Helpers createLocalizedTextShell should return a shell with all locales set to undefined when called.
Localization Shell Helpers createLocalizedTextsShell should return a shell with all locales set to undefined when called.
Goat It API Helpers createGoatItApiEndpoint should create the correct endpoint for a given resource name when called.
